text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Well, look whose birthday it is. I've got<n>something
for you.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
A present, huh? I don't suppose it's<n>monetary in
nature?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hah, as if you're the type who'd behappy with some cash in your card. No,this is a very special game.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Last time was poker, before that was<n>pool, and
we're standing at one win<n>each, right? So...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Next is baccarat, a game where you go<n>all in on
luck. The prize is a whole day of<n>the other's time.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
It's only luck, but still... that alone could<n>turn my
day into a blessing—or a curse.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh, haha! Ahahaha! Yeah, now that's<n>the best
kind of game to play on my<n>birthday!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
And what a game. All right, this'll be a<n>party of
pure insanity!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Damn, that really got your blood<n>flowing. You're
the only person I know<n>who'd be happy getting a
present like<n>this.
